6	verify-kani-mutation, verify-protocol-models) each ask "is a PROOF hollow?" This
7	one asks the level-up question the 2026-07-01 adversarial round found the tree
8	was blind to: **does the gate that polices hollowness actually RUN on the diff it
9	polices?** A gate that is green-when-run but never fires — wrong `paths:` filter,
10	`continue-on-error`, `workflow_dispatch`-only, or simply not invoked by any job —
11	is exactly as dangerous as a hollow proof (F1: `verify-ledger-consistency` never

13

15	asserts the wiring matches the declared enforcement:
16	  * per_pr_blocking — the declared `runs_in` workflow invokes `make <target>`, has a

18	    job/step is NOT `continue-on-error`, and the

29	    reason and optional workflow metadata are valid. Invalid metadata fails.

32	HARD FAIL (unwired); the invocation check inspects STEP-level `if:`/`continue-on-error`

208	def _covers(filter_globs: list[str], policed: str) -> bool:
209	    """Prove inclusion for equal patterns, catch-all, recursive literal roots,
210	    or a literal suffix under **/. Other glob inclusions fail conservatively.
211	
212	    A literal directory and directory/* do not cover directory/**. GitHub's
213	    path globs match the whole path; * cannot cross a slash.
214	    https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#filter-pattern-cheat-sheet
215	    """
216	    def literal(path: str) -> bool:
217	        return not any(char in path for char in "*?+[]!\\")

219	    for pattern in filter_globs:
220	        if pattern == policed or pattern == "**":
221	            return True
222	        if pattern.endswith("/**"):
223	            prefix = pattern[:-3]
224	            if prefix and literal(prefix) and policed.startswith(prefix + "/"):
225	                return True
226	        if pattern.startswith("**/"):
227	            suffix = pattern[3:]
228	            if literal(suffix) and literal(policed) and (
229	                policed == suffix or policed.endswith("/" + suffix)

419	    """Fail closed on path/branch forms that can suppress a blocking gate.

422	    in order. Proving whole-prefix coverage through arbitrary ordered
423	    include/exclude/re-include programs is outside this small lint, so those
424	    forms are rejected rather than silently approximated. A blocking gate must
425	    also cover the repository's protected `master` branch.

428	    has_ignore_filter = False
429	    if tg["pull_request"] is None:
430	        fails.append(
431	            f"{target}: per_pr_blocking but {runs_in} has no "
432	            "pull_request trigger (push alone does not gate PRs)."
433	        )
434	    pr = tg["pull_request"]
435	    if pr is not None and pr.get("types") is not None:
436	        activities = pr["types"]
437	        # GitHub's default PR activity set: opened, synchronize, reopened.
438	        # https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
439	        required = {"opened", "synchronize", "reopened"}

444	    for trig in ("push", "pull_request"):
445	        node = tg[trig]

449	        malformed = False

451	        for key in ("paths", "paths_ignore", "branches", "branches_ignore"):
